edges: The film 'Lost River' is set in Detroit, which is central to its narrative.
The film references the Heidelberg Project as an example of urban renewal in Detroit.
The film portrays the struggles of families in Detroit amidst destruction.
Lost River is set in Detroit, which is central to the film's narrative and aesthetic.
Ryan Gosling directed Lost River, marking his first feature film as a director.
Lost River portrays the themes of dereliction and hope in Detroit.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Ryan Gosling's film began as a collection of shots of the Brewster-Douglass Projects.
